title: roll tool accepts an empty reason string
description: Completeness review finding. packages/core/src/orchestrator/tools.ts rollTool only checks that reason is a string, so an empty reason is accepted, unlike mark_scene which rejects an empty title. The reason feeds the trace and audit trail. Parent context: loreweaver-d4r.
acceptance_criteria: rollTool rejects an empty reason; a test covers it.
close_reason: roll rejects empty reason strings; regression test added. Verification: npx vitest run packages/core/test/tools.test.ts passed (23 tests). Broader npm run typecheck and npx vitest run still fail on unrelated existing CLI baseline issues recorded in comments.

comments.author: Joseph Bongaarts
comments.text: Worktree baseline: npm run test -- packages/core/test/tools.test.ts -> failed before tests during tsc --build with existing CLI errors packages/cli/src/index.ts:111 TS2554 and TS2339.
